title: Guild:Painkillers
html:
Painkillers - [PK]
Leader Tarnaxy
Officers Testicleze, Phallicus, Mystori,
No. of members 5
Language English
Time zone EST (GMT -5)

Guild Overview

We are a small group of players focused highly on making gold and getting good experience. We like to have a good time, and not be serious all the time. Our members are intelligent and understand the workings of the game to a certain degree. If you need help with anything, give one of us a whisper. If the task is in their level range, I'm quite sure they'd be pleased to help you!

We hold purple item hunts on the weekends for members with tiny wallets. All you have to do is show up. I, Tarnaxy, will do all the required fighting. Most of the members in the posse are not quite to the point to take the Room of Creation on by themselves.

Latest News

December 1, 2008: Narox and his alt regnok have been kicked from Painkillers for starting an argument with the other members. This sort of behavior will NOT be tolerated in Painkillers.

November 31, 2008: Purple item hunts will be held on Saturdays and Sundays for any members wishing to make a bit of gold. We will meet at the Algernon portal in Townston 2 at 1 p.m. EST. The group will be led by Tarnaxy, through the Room of Creation. A loot bonus of +650% or +900% is to be expected.
